subject: MAP: load/perf test scheduling & dedicated-capacity sizing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finledger.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP milestone: schedule load/perf replay

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed next step we discussed:

Summary (from today's discovery)
- Goal: validate peak performance under realistic traffic to size Dedicated capacity before production cutover.
- Target peak: ~2k QPS sustained with short bursts to ~2.4kQPS during business hour peaks.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency <= 220ms, no OOMs, KV cache effectiveness observed after warmup.

Proposed MAP milestone (Load / Performance Test)
- Milestone: Traffic replay + capacity sizing run
- Owners: FinLedger (provide traffic sample + replay script), Redwood SE (Dev) run replay on dedicated capacity, Marissa coordinate schedule & pilot logistics
- Dependencies: traffic sample, access to test cluster (VPC peering or staging credentials), security questionnaire completion
- Target dates: propose test window Mar 31 — Apr 1 (2-hour scheduled run + warmup) and target close for the whole MAP April 9, 2026

Ask from you: Please confirm
1) that the QPS peaks above are accurate for the replay (we can scale the replay up/down)
2) availability for the proposed window (Mar 31 — Apr 1)
3) who on your side will own providing the traffic sample & replay script (file format: ndjson / event timestamps preferred)

Technical notes I want to flag before we schedule:
- We recommend a small baseline run on staging to validate replay tooling and tokenization parity before the full capacity run.
- For the full run we'd provision dedicated capacity so we can guarantee throughput and minimize noisy neighbor variance. Dev (cc'd) will propose the sizing.

I've attached a placeholder list of artifacts we'll need and a sample MAP milestone doc we can iterate on.

Attachments: finledger-traffic-sample.json (placeholder), replay-config.yaml (placeholder)

Thanks — I can lock the calendar once I have confirmation and Dev's sizing.

Marissa

Date: 2026-03-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP milestone: schedule load/perf replay

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Peak numbers: confirmed. Our telemetry shows typical peak ~1.8k QPS with brief bursts to ~2.4k. For the replay we'd like you to run a scaled replay that hits the 2.4k burst target for 10–15 minutes and sustains ~1.8k for 90 minutes.
- Traffic sample: I'll own providing the sample and the replay script. I'll upload the first slice to the shared Drive by EOD tomorrow. Format will be ndjson with timestamp and session_id.
- Window: Mar 31 — Apr 1 works for our Ops team. Preferred test window: Mar 31 22:00 — Mar 31 23:30 PT (off-peak for our users, but representative load), with a warmup starting 21:30. If Redwood prefers another slot, let me know.
- Security / procurement: procurement will require SOC2 evidence and a short security checklist filled out (we started the questionnaire during the call). I can expedite via our security team.

Attaching: finledger-traffic-sample.json, replay-config.yaml (these are small placeholders — full set to be uploaded to Drive).

Elena

Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + MAP milestone: schedule load/perf replay — request for sizing & test plan

Dev — looping you in to own the technical run. Key asks:
- Recommend dedicated capacity profile (GPU type/count, memory, network) to hit sustained 1.8k QPS and absorb 2.4kQPS bursts with headroom. Please include: expected tokens/sec per GPU assumption, recommended KV cache warmup duration, and any changes to model variant we should run during the replay.
- Confirm test time and the total runway you need (e.g., 30m warmup + 90m sustained + 15m burst).
- Provide a rough cost estimate for the run and an ETA for the redwood-capacity-estimate.xlsx so I can share with procurement.

Rishi — can you confirm whether we need to offer any credits or trial terms to unblock procurement? FinLedger hinted they may request a short-term commitment if we need dedicated capacity for the run.

Elena — thank you for the attachments; Dev will review and propose. I'll hold the tentative slot but won't lock until Dev confirms sizing.

Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finledger.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + MAP milestone: schedule load/perf replay — request for sizing & test plan

Thanks Marissa / Elena — quick technical plan below after reviewing the traffic sample and requirements.

High-level recommendation (initial sizing)
- Instance profile: 4 x A100-80GB (pinned, dedicated pool) as baseline. Each A100 expected to sustain ~450–500 QPS for the model variant you described with KV cache warm. Headroom: 4 x 500 = 2k sustained. To comfortably absorb a 2.4k burst target, add 1 spare A100 (provision 5 total) or alternatively run on 3x higher-throughput H100 if available.
- KV cache warmup: plan for 30 minutes of prefix warmup before the measured window.
- Replay plan: 30m warmup, 90m sustained @1.8k QPS, 15m burst to 2.4k QPS, 15m cool-down — total ~2.5 hours.
- Observability: we'll stream detailed token-level traces and latency percentiles to your S3 bucket (or shared Drive link) during the run.

Resource & cost estimate
- Draft estimate attached: redwood-capacity-estimate.xlsx (includes GPU hours and a one-time engineering support fee). I'll update numbers after we select exact instance family (A100 vs H100).
- Note on private vs hosted: For deterministic results we recommend dedicating capacity in a dedicated pool (Reserved for the run). We can also do a VPC-connected private plane if you require additional network controls — will need 1 week lead time for networking.

Next steps from our side
- I'll provision a test cluster and share the cluster access & replay runner by Mar 25 so you can validate the replay tooling on a small subset.
- If Mar 31 slot works, I'll provision capacity for Mar 30 evening to run the warmup.

If procurement needs a formal cost breakdown or an SOW, loop Rishi and I can provide.

— Dev

Elena
